translations.web: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.
translations.bsb: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.
translations.kjv: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
